glosses: fisher, fisherman (male or of unspecified gender)
component part in various compound nouns, e.g. Amazonasfischer (“Amazon kingfisher”), Austernfischer (“oystercatcher”)
component part in various compounds for different kinds of fishing boats, e.g. Grundschleppnetzfischer (“trawler”)

examples.text: Mein Vater ist ein erfahrener Fischer.
examples.en: My father is a skilled fisherman.

examples.text: Die Fischer hoffen auf reichen Fang.
examples.en: The fishermen are hoping for a big catch.
Tom is a hunter and fisherman.
